name: Sensors and interfaces
notes: Original generic teaching artwork informed by manufacturer circuit conventions, not claimed IEC symbols or manufacturer package pinouts. Existing capacitor/diode graphics are reused where appropriate. All supplies are explicit. Artwork does not implement sensing, switching or modulation models.

entries.name: Test point
entries.convention: A single native passive pin ending directly at an open circle.

entries.name: Hall-effect sensor
entries.convention: Generic powered Hall sensor with H and an incoming B arrow; not a bare four-terminal Hall element.

entries.name: Piezoelectric sensor
entries.convention: Existing capacitor electrodes and terminals with a central piezo element and force arrow; generic transducer, not an ordinary crystal resonator.

entries.name: Voltage-output light sensor
entries.convention: Powered photodetector interface containing the existing diode body and two incoming light arrows.

entries.name: Voltage-output pressure sensor
entries.convention: Powered sensor block containing a diaphragm and incoming pressure arrow; generic conditioned voltage output.

entries.name: Voltage-output temperature sensor
entries.convention: Powered temperature-to-voltage interface with a thermometer motif; distinct from a thermistor.

entries.name: Moisture sensor
entries.convention: Two interleaved resistive electrodes and water-drop motif; no supply pin or invented digital interface.

entries.name: High-impedance pH probe interface
entries.convention: Two-terminal pH electrode interface drawn as a labelled source circle; signal and reference remain distinct.

entries.name: Voltage-controlled analogue switch
entries.convention: Open analogue switch contacts with a dashed actuation link and a separate differential control pair.

entries.name: AM modulator functional circuit
entries.convention: Labelled AM functional block with multiplier motif and separate carrier/message differential inputs; carrier bias and modulation law require an explicit model.
